card.name: Start of a word split mid-term
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that is split into parts, such as 'contr' before 'aindicated', 'S' in Vincristine Sulfate, or 'c' in ciprofloxacin. Mostly in drug-label warnings.

modes.label: Contraindicated start

modes.description: The opening piece of an ordinary word in non-medical text.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd word-piece continuations, with no coherent theme.
card.plain: It fires on the first fragment of a word that is split in pieces, especially 'contr' of contraindicated and Vincristine Sulfate.
